_README: REI BlackBook selectors. Most are CONFIRMED/VERIFY from the account's own automation (build 58f8bd4). This app's native send flow = open contact -> Chat tab -> type (TinyMCE iframe) -> Send Text; it does NOT natively do a separate Opt-In or ProfitDial from-number pick, so those keys are blank until captured via `npx playwright codegen`. The engine fails closed: if REQUIRE_OPTIN / REQUIRE_PROFITDIAL are on and their selectors are missing, the contact goes to Needs Review (never sent without them).
